# pip-audit-ignore.txt
#
# Advisory IDs to WAIVE during `pip-audit` (see .github/workflows/supply-chain.yml,
# job `pip-audit`). One advisory per line; `#` starts a comment; blank lines ignored.
# Each entry is passed to pip-audit as `--ignore-vuln <ID>`.
#
# Format:  GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx  |  PYSEC-YYYY-NNN  |  CVE-YYYY-NNNNN
# Policy:  An entry here means the advisory has been triaged and consciously accepted
#          (not reachable from our code path, or no fixed release is available yet).
#          Every waiver MUST carry a justification comment and a tracking link.
#          Un-waived vulnerabilities fail the job closed.
#
# Example (commented out; this repo currently waives nothing):
# GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx  # <package>: not reachable; only <api> is used. Track: OS#NNN
